text: Job's a building. Cut the backup, walk out, get paid. I don't ask about the rest.
style: A plant maintenance technician in his forties, sent to break the one thing that would have held the load. Consistent Korean-American accent, Pacific Northwest, throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Mid-low pitch; short sentences, steady pace. Practical, terse, hands-first. Not a believer, and increasingly aware of it.
